spec.rationale: Prospective calibration cohort ineligible: registration is after the expected publication window even though the FY2026 TTM metric is not yet resolvable from admitted sec_companyfacts at the information cutoff. Types the owner-earnings leg of the operating_business_and_net_assets prose falsifier. The low-case owner_earnings_reinvestment_dcf proof locks the owner_earnings fact at 13,288 USD millions (FY2025 operating cash flow tag on accession 0000858877-25-000111). Resolution uses normalized_owner_earnings_ttm_m_v2 (TTM operating cash flow minus absolute TTM capital expenditures via sec_companyfacts_ttm). If trailing-twelve-month normalized owner earnings at FY2026 year-end (2026-07-25) resolve below that low-case anchor, distributable owner cash has fallen below the low-case bridge and the bounded per-share range should compress toward the low case (31.89 USD per share vs 58.05 base). Incremental after-tax ROIC and reinvestment-rate legs remain judgment inputs without a resolvable SEC metric and are not typed here. Historical adapter replay on Q3 FY2025 (measurement end 2025-04-26) resolved 12,803 USD millions via sec_companyfacts_ttm at the prior author pass. At registration (2026-10-17), sec_companyfacts_ttm returns ttm_period_inputs_missing for the FY2026 target even though the admitted DOWNLOAD_MANIFEST lists the FY2026 10-K (accession 0000858877-26-000132, filed 2026-09-02); the forecast therefore remains ex ante on adapter observability, not on filing absence. Component fingerprint unchanged; only the work-item input digest rebinding (93ed3c5b3ec4ae63b3923f89bc785cf2fd7a4dc9) — forecast thresholds and probability were not adapted to post-cutoff evidence. A 34% fire probability weights interim cash softness against Cisco fiscal Q4 seasonality and historically sticky enterprise networking cash flow.
